editionLabel: HABA English section of multilingual rules (2014)
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a caterpillar begins by rolling the die.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise. The memory variant uses the basic rules with changes to the body pieces, not to the starting player.

sources.title: Caterpillar Dice: multilingual rules, English section

internalEvidence: The HABA-authored multilingual booklet preserved by Ludism was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 30098. PDF page 4 (printed page 5) and PDF page 15 were rendered and visually checked. The English How to Play section says the last person to see a caterpillar begins by rolling, and play is clockwise. The memory variant follows the basic rules except its stated component changes. The back page identifies Habermaaß GmbH and a January 2014 printing. Mirror PDF SHA-256: aa4e7be070584bbcf47a57c495053cd6208390d1afd0002e6d630bf4870a6642. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The booklet does not provide a fallback if no player recalls seeing a caterpillar or two players saw one together.
